title.zh: Prompt 不是玄学，是可以回归测试的代码
title.en: Prompts Aren't Magic — They're Code You Can Regression-Test

subtitle.zh: AI-FDE 转型之路 · AI 工程 02-Prompt工程
subtitle.en: The AI-FDE Transition Path · AI Engineering 02 — Prompt Engineering

summary.zh: Prompt 是 AI 项目里唯一「谁都能改、但没人负责」的地方。把它当代码管：存文件、记改动、跑回归题。
summary.en: Prompts are the one place in an AI project that anyone can change and nobody owns. Treat them like code: keep them in files, log every change, and run a regression set.
